describing.paraphrase: A motivation for describing a target.

concepts.title: Risk Register Entry
concepts.authored_definition: A managed register record about exactly one RiskCase in this profile. Distinct entries, source systems or registers can record the same case. A software record is an implementation record, not an additional risk subject.
concepts.rationale: Retain generic documentary-entity context without importing case identity or cardinality rules. A register entry is a record about the analytical risk item, not another risk subject.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-01 targets one RiskCase in this profile and permits zero or many entries per case. R-33 relates distinct entry revisions to their entry; RX-008 assigns register membership. Neither an entry identifier nor organizational admission is the case's universal existence condition.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Description
concepts.authored_definition: A descriptive information item about a risk case, pattern or scenario with an explicit description role and source.
concepts.rationale: Retain describing motivation as related documentary-function context. The source term is a motivation instance, not a class equivalent to RiskDescription or its risk referent.
concepts.context_interpretation: RK2-007/RK2-008/R-37 preserve case, pattern and scenario targets; R-39 qualifies description function. C-09 requires a published description target under its profile. Source/description context does not establish an actual occurrence or turn the description into its case.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Consequence Statement
concepts.authored_definition: An information item expressing a possible or reported consequence; it is not the consequence itself.
concepts.rationale: Retain descriptive-function context while separating a possible/reported consequence statement from an outcome. The motivation does not supply consequence semantics or establish realization.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-22 concerns the analytical RiskCase; R-40 retains a source slot and RX-010 permits no actual-outcome referent (0..1). A recorded possible consequence must not be promoted into an observed outcome merely to populate a field.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Identification Information
concepts.authored_definition: Recorded information about identifying a risk, including the stated source, channel, agent and available time information.
concepts.rationale: Retain attribution as a partial provenance comparison. Attribution of an identification document does not define the complete source/channel/participant/time record or mean that an agent created the RiskCase.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-07 identifies the analytical risk item, R-08 records actor references and R-27 records intake channels. R-52 connects the information to revisions. Documentary attribution is kept separate from actual risk causation, operational admission and available temporal precision.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Intake Channel Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value naming how risk information entered the registration process; it is not a risk source. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for an intake-channel value. The channel describes how information arrived; it is not a real-world contributor to risk or a universal channel taxonomy.
concepts.context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm and VocabularyConcept preserves InformationArtifact identity. R-27 records a source-qualified channel; common text neither identifies the vocabulary resource nor resolves a risk source.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Description Role Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value specifying the function of a description, such as title, summary or scenario description. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain controlled vocabulary context for description function. Selecting a term such as title or summary does not itself create a description, a scenario or the described risk subject.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-39 supplies the selected function of a RiskDescription. Scheme-qualified term identity is inherited through ClassificationTerm/VocabularyConcept; retained groups remain incomplete and non-disjoint without a new semantic approval.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Consequence Slot Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value preserving the source-defined position or role of a consequence statement. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for the source-defined consequence position/function. A slot is not a universal outcome ordering, a severity value or an actual consequence.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-40 preserves the original statement's source slot. The inherited documentary identity does not equate identical strings across schemes or force a scalar selection when multiple assertions apply.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Register
concepts.authored_definition: A managed informational register that organizes risk-entry records for a stated organizational scope and purpose. Its documentary identity does not make it an OntoUML collective or physical aggregate.
concepts.rationale: Retain collection membership as related information-level context. Riskium adds register scope, purpose and documentary governance without equating the register with an OntoUML collective or physical aggregate.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-008 organizes entry records, while entries and their revisions keep separate identities. Register membership does not establish one-to-one case identity or require every analytical RiskCase to be operationally admitted.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Analysis State Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value describing progress of analysis under a specified analysis-state scheme. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for analysis progress. A value under a declared analysis scheme is not the state of a real-world risk situation or evidence of assessment quality.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-31 optionally records analysis state in a RecordStateAssertion. Scheme/version and temporal qualification matter; incomplete or absent state information is not silently replaced by a workflow value or an invented completion result.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Workflow State Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value describing handling or processing status under a specified workflow scheme. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for handling/processing status. A workflow label such as Closed does not establish risk cessation, successful treatment or actual authorization.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-32 records an optional workflow value; RX-029 and RX-030 link a workflow assignment to its value and scheme version. C-19 preserves unknown rules/authority as unknown. The term resource is not the assignment situation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Record State Assertion
concepts.authored_definition: A qualified statement about a record's state, preserving the source and available temporal precision.
concepts.rationale: Retain annotation as related statement/target context. Riskium additionally preserves record aboutness, source and available time precision; no Annotation serialization contract or state-situation equivalence is adopted.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-23 attaches the statement to an EntryRevision, R-31/R-32 can retain separate analysis/workflow values, and RX-032 optionally documents a WorkflowAssignment. The statement remains documentary; the assignment remains a situation. Corrections and lineage follow C-03/C-24 without overwriting issued content.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

boundaries.static_scope: Selected source relations, identity suppliers and constraint statements only; no new workflow engine, data-population, SQL or ontology-engine execution.
boundaries.semantic_review: Independent semantic review remains #23; exact normative adoption remains #78.
boundaries.deployment_scope: Previews remain planning artifacts; complete component qualification and publication/readback remain separate.

batch_findings: All eleven authored definitions, direct edge records and inherited edges are unchanged. Every selected concept still inherits InformationArtifact identity; four have the revised RiskCase as a direct association neighbor. Excluding the blanket artifact set preserves subtype edges without inventing sibling exclusivity or complete coverage.

The selected source contracts keep register entries, continuing risk items, entry revisions and register membership separate. An entry concerns one case in this profile, but a case can have zero or many entries. EntryRevision retains ArtifactVersion identity; correction/lineage obligations remain source statements rather than a new overwrite or migration implementation.

Description, consequence and record-state statements remain information about referents. A possible outcome link and the statement-to-workflow-assignment link remain optional. WorkflowAssignment remains a situation under a scheme version and revision; the statement documenting it is not that situation.

Analysis/workflow values are scheme-qualified vocabulary resources, not real-world risk states. Closure does not establish cessation or effectiveness; missing rule/authority remains unknown. These commitments are documented without claiming actual workflow execution, complete task data or independent semantic approval.
context_guard_note: Documentary identity is separate from analytical RiskCase identity and local operational admission. Shared parenthood creates no blanket exclusivity or covering axiom. Vocabulary values, qualified statements and their referents remain distinct; closure and missing authorization do not supply new risk/effectiveness/permission facts.
source_access_note: All three primary responses were directly retrieved and match the historical response hashes. Selected anchor fingerprints, versions and locators are retained without redistributing documents. Web Annotation describing is a motivation instance, not a class equivalent to RiskDescription or ConsequenceStatement. No PROV/SKOS/Annotation conformance, imported axiom or complete semantic preservation is asserted.
